newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Tristate shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Tristate shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of garment and property investment concern Tristate Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.

The company said it asked for the trading suspension pending an announcement of the results of a court meeting and its special general meeting on Friday morning in relation to a privatisation proposal.
Tristate also said it had requested the resumption of its shares trading on Monday.
In January, Tristate's controlling shareholders proposed a privatisation plan under which minority shareholders would receive HK$4.80 in cash for each Tristate share held.
